units: inches unless noted; STEP is AP242 from Onshape (AndyMark am-5850), OCP imports as mm
axes: Y up; X = pivot axis direction (red hive at -X, blue at +X); Z = audience/scoring direction

pivot.axis: line Y=43.95 in, Z=0, parallel to X

rocker.note: densities are guesses by part name; ribs/skins dominate; treat mass/CG as a sweep range

dampers.model: Blum Blumotion 970A hydraulic soft-close piston, 4 total (2 per hive)
dampers.note: no published force curve; calibrate as velocity-dependent end-stop damper

retrieval_opening_in._source: am-5855 drawing via PHYSICS_AND_SIMULATION.md 10.7: 'a retrieval opening 3.55 in tall by 3.57 in deep at the bottom'. This is what makes the bottom ring 'pass POLLEN and block NECTAR' -- it is geometry, not a filter: a 2.80 in POLLEN fits through and a 3.62 in NECTAR does not, so a NECTAR plug cannot be pulled back out.

staging_note: POLLEN/NECTAR are placed in the STEP at their staged positions (flowers, gardens, cells, alliance areas)
